senses.gloss: m. (רוק to be clear, v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. IV, p. 486) straining bag.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 42b:9">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>בדר׳</he> when the drink is made by pouring water on the strainer (and the lees contained in it), opp. <he>דפורצנא</he>.—Pl. <he>רְוָוקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:13">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>הני ר׳ דארמאי וכ׳</he> straining bags which have been used by gentiles, if made of hair &c.
